The processed instrumental database comprises `r RECORDS_N` particle-velocity records with longitudinal (L), transverse (T), and vertical (V) components, corresponding to `r RECORDS_N_COMPONENTS` component time histories. The blasting contractor reported source-to-receptor distance and MIC for `r RECORDS_N_META` records; these documented conditions span distances from `r formatC(min(RECORDS_META$D), format = "f", digits = 0L)` to `r formatC(max(RECORDS_META$D), format = "f", digits = 0L)` m and charges from `r formatC(min(RECORDS_META$Q), format = "f", digits = 0L)` to `r formatC(max(RECORDS_META$Q), format = "f", digits = 0L)` kg. The time histories share a sampling frequency of `r formatC(RECORDS_FS, format = "f", digits = 0L)` Hz and span durations from `r formatC(RECORDS_DURATION[1L], format = "f", digits = 2L)` to `r formatC(RECORDS_DURATION[2L], format = "f", digits = 2L)` s. The 5%-damped pseudoacceleration spectra comprise `r length(RECORDS_TN)` periods between `r formatC(min(RECORDS_TN), format = "f", digits = 3L)` and `r formatC(max(RECORDS_TN), format = "f", digits = 3L)` s.

In L, T, and V order, the median PPA values are `r paste(formatC(RECORDS_PEAKS[match(RECORDS_COMPONENTS, OCID), PPA50], format = "f", digits = 3L), collapse = ", ")` g, and the empirical p16--p84 intervals are `r paste(sprintf("[%s--%s]", formatC(RECORDS_PEAKS[match(RECORDS_COMPONENTS, OCID), PPA16], format = "f", digits = 3L), formatC(RECORDS_PEAKS[match(RECORDS_COMPONENTS, OCID), PPA84], format = "f", digits = 3L)), collapse = ", ")` g. The median PPV values are `r paste(formatC(RECORDS_PEAKS[match(RECORDS_COMPONENTS, OCID), PPV50], format = "f", digits = 2L), collapse = ", ")` mm/s, and their p16--p84 intervals are `r paste(sprintf("[%s--%s]", formatC(RECORDS_PEAKS[match(RECORDS_COMPONENTS, OCID), PPV16], format = "f", digits = 2L), formatC(RECORDS_PEAKS[match(RECORDS_COMPONENTS, OCID), PPV84], format = "f", digits = 2L)), collapse = ", ")` mm/s.
